nombre: medidas de tendencia central con la pasita aprendiz

hobby.detalle: la Pasita, aprendiz de idol en un show de audiciones donde 5 jueces la califican

arte.universo: An original K-pop survival audition TV show world at night: a huge glossy audition stage with an LED floor, magenta and violet spotlights sweeping through haze, confetti cannons, a big blank LED screen behind the stage (screens show only abstract light, never digits or letters). In front of the stage there is a long glowing judges' desk with EXACTLY 5 judges seated in a row. The judges are simple round generic characters (not the Pasita, not existing people or characters), each identified only by a solid color outfit: blue, mint, yellow, dark purple and orange. The dark purple one is the rival judge: dark purple suit, sunglasses, crossed arms, smug look. Each judge raises a plain white rectangular scoreboard paddle; the paddles are always blank (never draw digits, letters or marks on them). The Pasita is a trainee idol: coral-pink training jacket over a white top, sneakers, a headset microphone, and a blank trainee badge with only the PASAS raisin-in-a-circle emblem. Palette: deep purple and indigo night, magenta spotlights, coral-pink accent glow, warm gold sparkles. No text, digits, letters, logos or brand marks anywhere in the image.

post:
¿Media, mediana y moda no te entran? Piénsalo como en un show de audiciones: 5 jueces califican a la Pasita… y un juez rival le pone un 2. 🎤

Así se explica en PASAS: cada tema con lo que te gusta (videojuegos, anime, K-pop o fútbol).

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdala para tu examen de estadística.

pasos.t: **Media:** suma y divide entre cuántos datos son.
**Mediana:** ordena y toma el de en medio (si son pares, promedia los 2 centrales).
**Moda:** el dato que más se repite.
